promotionalText: Experience real-time Zings, sovereign @handle.quantzing.com identity, live ZingSpaces audio rooms, and Quanty AI in a True Dark OLED interface.
description:
QuantZing is the sovereign real-time social platform built on the open AT Protocol and integrated with QuantOS.

Why QuantZing:
- Zings, Rezings & Quote Zings: Fast, expressive real-time conversations with media, threads, and custom algorithmic feeds.
- Portable Sovereign Handle: Claim your @handle.quantzing.com or @handle.quantzing.in identity backed by cryptographic ATProto repositories.
- Quanty: Ask Quanty to analyze breaking news, synthesize long threads, or draft high-signal Zings.
- ZingSpaces: Host and join live audio rooms with real-time speaker controls.
- QuantZing Pro: Access verified badges, creator monetization, and advanced feed controls.
- True Dark Interface: High-contrast OLED #000000 canvas built for effortless reading day or night.
